'''Jordi Torres''' (born 19 July 1964) is an Andorran [[Alpine skiing|alpine skier]]. He competed in [[Alpine skiing at the 1984 Winter Olympics|three events]] at the [[1984 Winter Olympics]].<ref name="SportsRef">{{cite Sports-Reference |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/to/jordi-torres-1.html |title=Jordi Torres |access-date=20 March 2018 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200418073834/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/to/jordi-torres-1.html |archive-date=18 April 2020}}</ref>
